FFmpeg 7.1.5 — "export-ass" LGPL static build for macOS arm64 + x86_64
STATUS: arm64 APPROVED. x86_64 BUILT, NOT APPROVED (catalog entry stays pending; see below).
Built 2026-10-07 on an Apple Silicon Mac (macOS 27.0.1, build 26A434).

Purpose: Right Suite export pipelines in one binary:
  - libass `subtitles` / `ass` filters  (GenRight .ass burn-in)
  - FreeType + HarfBuzz `drawtext`       (CutRight caption burn-in)
  - zlib (PNG), h264_videotoolbox + AAC encode,
keeping the catalog's LGPL-only, no-autodetect posture (no --enable-gpl, no --enable-nonfree).

Recipe: crates/rightkit-ffmpeg/recipes/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh (pinned sources and their
        upstream evidence in recipes/ffmpeg-sources.json; the build refuses unpinned or
        mismatched sources).

FFmpeg configure (exact; arm64):
  --disable-gpl --disable-nonfree --disable-autodetect --enable-static --disable-shared
  --disable-doc --disable-debug --disable-ffplay --enable-small --arch=arm64
  --cc='clang -arch arm64' --enable-libass --enable-libfreetype --enable-libharfbuzz
  --enable-zlib --enable-videotoolbox --enable-audiotoolbox --pkg-config-flags=--static
x86_64 is identical except --arch=x86_64 --cc='clang -arch x86_64'
  --enable-cross-compile --target-os=darwin (placed after --cc).
No --extra-cflags/--extra-ldflags: include and library paths come only from the private
prefix's .pc files, so the embedded configuration string holds no build-host path.
pkg-config is confined to that prefix (PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR=<prefix>/lib/pkgconfig,
PKG_CONFIG_PATH unset), so no Homebrew/host library can be linked.

Dependency builds (static, into the private prefix, -arch <arch>):
  FreeType 2.13.3  autotools  --host=<aarch64|x86_64>-apple-darwin --without-zlib
                              --without-bzip2 --without-png --without-harfbuzz --without-brotli
  FriBidi 1.0.16   meson      -Ddocs=false -Dbin=false -Dtests=false -Ddeprecated=true
                              built only from files present in the upstream git tag (the
                              tarball's autotools output, man pages and 6 pre-generated
                              lib/*.tab.i + lib/fribidi-unicode-version.h are deleted and the
                              tables regenerated from the tagged Unicode data by host-built
                              generators). Post-delete tree: 122 files, all byte-identical
                              to tag v1.0.16, 0 files not in the tag.
  HarfBuzz 10.1.0  meson      -Dfreetype=enabled (hb-ft, required by drawtext) and glib,
                              gobject, cairo, icu, graphite, coretext, chafa, wasm, tests,
                              docs, utilities, introspection, benchmark disabled
  libass 0.17.3    autotools  --disable-fontconfig --enable-coretext
                              --disable-require-system-font-provider
Both arches use an explicit meson cross file ([binaries] c/cpp = clang -arch <arch>,
[host_machine] darwin/<aarch64|x86_64>); CC/CXX/CFLAGS are unset for meson so its
build-machine compiler stays the host clang. ZERO_AR_DATE=1.

Tool versions:
  Apple clang 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2), macOS SDK 27.0 (Xcode-27-RC)
  meson 1.12.1, ninja 1.13.2 (PyPI wheel; reports 1.13.2.git.kitware.jobserver-pipe-1)
    both pip-installed into a throwaway venv inside the build work directory
    (Homebrew Python 3.14.6); passed to the recipe as MESON=/NINJA=. Nothing installed
    on the system or in the workspace.
  pkg-config 3.0.7 (/opt/homebrew/bin/pkg-config; prefix-confined as above)
  NASM 3.02 (/opt/homebrew/bin/nasm; x86_64 assembly)
  /usr/bin/make, /usr/bin/ar, /usr/bin/strip

  libass-0.17.3.tar.xz
    eae425da50f0015c21f7b3a9c7262a910f0218af469e22e2931462fed3c50959

  The build host has no gpg; signatures were checked with a minimal OpenPGP v4 verifier
  (Python `cryptography` 50.0.2 in the same throwaway venv), which also rejected a
  one-byte-tampered tarball and a signature/file mismatch. No LAME source or
  --enable-libmp3lame appears in the recipe, sources or configure line (CONFIG_LIBMP3LAME 0).

Binaries (vendor/ffmpeg-lgpl/, untracked):
  ffmpeg-export-ass-macos-arm64   sha256 08f310879e64b348befa7c566c00aa5b6c67e9b64b082fa424f4a181ebd538b8
                                  16092616 bytes, Mach-O 64-bit arm64
  ffmpeg-export-ass-macos-x86_64  sha256 5d6bbfe66f60b4b8a4fcf66d779c3269a38d6d47fe83093238a308c0ab4b12ce
                                  19436048 bytes, Mach-O 64-bit x86_64
Reproducibility: each arch was built twice from scratch in two different work directories;
both pairs are byte-identical (cmp), as are the notice files. The binaries contain no
build-host path.

Verification
  otool -L (both arches, identical): only /usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib, libiconv.2.dylib,
    libz.1.dylib and /System/Library/Frameworks/{AudioToolbox, CoreAudio,
    ApplicationServices, CoreFoundation, VideoToolbox, CoreMedia, CoreVideo, CoreServices,
    CoreText}. zlib, iconv, CoreText, VideoToolbox and AudioToolbox are Apple system
    components.
  arm64 (executed):
    -version: "ffmpeg version 7.1.5"; -buildconf = the configure line above, exactly.
    -L: "GNU Lesser General Public License ... version 2.1 of the License, or (at your
        option) any later version"; no "GNU General Public License" line.
        configure: "License: LGPL version 2.1 or later"; config.h CONFIG_GPL 0, CONFIG_NONFREE 0.
    -filters: ass, drawtext, subtitles.  -encoders: aac, h264_videotoolbox (and aac_at).
    Burn-in: a 2 s black 320x240 clip + 440 Hz sine encoded h264_videotoolbox/AAC MP4,
      frame at 1 s decoded to gray8: plain 0 bright (>128) pixels; `subtitles=` with an .ass
      (Helvetica via CoreText) 1799 bright pixels in rows 150-239 and 0 in rows 0-99;
      `drawtext=fontfile=/System/Library/Fonts/Helvetica.ttc` 1658 and 0. Decoded frames were
      inspected visually (legible "BURNED IN" / "CAPTION"). tests/export_ass_e2e.rs repeats
      this through the catalog (digest + build probe) on every `cargo test`.
  x86_64 (NOT executed: the build host has no Rosetta 2, "Bad CPU type in executable"):
    static evidence only — the embedded configuration string equals the configure line
    above; configure reported "License: LGPL version 2.1 or later"; config.h CONFIG_GPL 0,
    CONFIG_NONFREE 0, FFMPEG_LICENSE "LGPL version 2.1 or later"; config.h CONFIG_* and
    config_components.h are identical to arm64 (CONFIG_ASS_FILTER, CONFIG_SUBTITLES_FILTER,
    CONFIG_DRAWTEXT_FILTER, CONFIG_AAC_ENCODER, CONFIG_H264_VIDEOTOOLBOX_ENCODER all 1).
    To approve: on an x86_64-capable macOS host confirm the digest, run -buildconf,
    -filters, -encoders and -L, then record sha256 + size in catalog/artifacts.json, set
    status approved and delete pending.

Statically linked components (licence -> notice file shipped with the binary):
  FreeType 2.13.3     FTL (FTL option of FTL OR GPL-2.0-or-later)
                                          third-party/FreeType-FTL.txt (docs/FTL.TXT)
  FriBidi 1.0.16      LGPL-2.1-or-later   third-party/FriBidi-COPYING.txt
  HarfBuzz 10.1.0     MIT-Modern-Variant  third-party/HarfBuzz-COPYING.txt
                      (COPYING's licence body is identical, whitespace/case-normalised, to
                      the SPDX MIT-Modern-Variant text. src/ms-use/COPYING — Microsoft, MIT —
                      covers USE data files that feed a generated shaping table.)
  libass 0.17.3       ISC                 third-party/libass-COPYING.txt
  FFmpeg 7.1.5        LGPL-2.1-or-later   third-party/LGPL-2.1.txt
Binary SPDX: LGPL-2.1-or-later AND FTL AND MIT-Modern-Variant AND ISC
LGPL obligations: FFmpeg and FriBidi are statically linked into one executable;
ship the notices plus a written source offer covering their complete sources and this
recipe so a recipient can rebuild/relink. FreeType's FTL requires the credit line in
product documentation.

To reproduce (from rightkit/crates/rightkit-ffmpeg on a macOS build host):
  recipes/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh fetch --variant export-ass --sources <src-dir>
  MESON=<venv>/bin/meson NINJA=<venv>/bin/ninja recipes/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh build \
    --variant export-ass --arch arm64|x86_64 --tool ffmpeg \
    --sources <src-dir> --work <work-dir> --out <out-dir>
  <out-dir>/ffmpeg-export-ass-macos-<arch>.evidence.json records sha256, size, the
  configuration, tool versions and otool -L.
contentSha256 of the macOS arm64 build (signature-independent catalog identity, src/content_digest.rs): d94312160fccd06773132ddd7527e1cce676222294a102b86d24fbb01dfa7c22
